name: BitLocker
short_description: BitLocker is the full-volume drive encryption feature built into Windows. On a dev box the disk is already encrypted, so enabling BitLocker manually can lock users out.

evidence.quote: turning on BitLocker yourself can lock you out of the dev box you were trying to protect
Say you have 10 devices and BitLocker encryption is enabled on eight of them.
We tell ourselves that BitLocker is enough
